nodes.label: mcp dependency
nodes.rationale: MCP CLI/SDK that exposes the data layer over stdio to Claude Desktop, OpenCode, OpenWork, and Cursor.

nodes.label: Cursor Setup
nodes.rationale: Cursor and other hook-less MCP clients get the checkpointing behavior by pasting tool instructions into .cursorrules, CLAUDE.md, or equivalent system prompt.

nodes.label: PreCompact Hook
nodes.rationale: Guaranteed system-event checkpointing (Claude Code PreCompact, OpenCode compacting hook, generic_loop trigger) contrasted as more reliable than instruction-following because the agent cannot know its own window state.

nodes.label: Context Layer
nodes.rationale: Shared durable memory so AI sessions stop re-explaining tasks and re-litigating decisions; handoffs persist task, decisions with why, next steps, and raw conversation.

nodes.label: BGE Small Embedding Model
nodes.rationale: BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 ONNX (~90MB, 384-dim) downloaded once from HuggingFace then run offline via onnxruntime/fastembed; preloaded at server startup to avoid post-event-loop load hang.

nodes.label: Graph Lineage (continues_from)
nodes.rationale: Handoffs chain via continues_from into a traversable per-task lineage graph walkable in both directions with get_handoff_lineage or SurrealQL traversal.

nodes.label: Handoff Record
nodes.rationale: Checkpoint unit carrying task_slug, git_branch, status lifecycle, decisions with rationale, next steps, raw_content, embedding, token_count, timestamp.

nodes.label: HNSW Vector Index
nodes.rationale: SurrealDB nearest-neighbor index (DIMENSION 384, DIST COSINE, TYPE F32) keeping KNN semantic search fast at thousands of handoffs; embedding field optional so pre-feature handoffs do not break.

nodes.label: MCP Tools (9 tools)
nodes.rationale: Data layer exposed over stdio as native tools for any MCP client so no per-platform glue code is needed; covers create, resume, search, lineage, append, close, summarize, capsule.

nodes.label: Semantic Search (offline embeddings)
nodes.rationale: Meaning-based retrieval without API keys using local bge-small embeddings and HNSW KNN; small model chosen as plenty for related-handoff recall with upgrade path to bge-base 768-dim.

nodes.label: SurrealDB
nodes.rationale: Local persistent store for handoffs, BM25 full-text index, HNSW vector index, and continues_from graph relation; one standalone server avoids dual embedded RocksDB access.

nodes.label: anthropic dependency
nodes.rationale: Only needed for auto_summarize_handoff; lazy client keeps every other keyless tool working without ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

nodes.label: fastembed dependency
nodes.rationale: Pins the local embedding engine that powers offline semantic search with no API key.

nodes.label: surrealdb dependency
nodes.rationale: Python driver for the SurrealDB 3.x server holding handoffs, indexes, and lineage graph.

nodes.label: Instruction-Based Checkpointing
nodes.rationale: MCP has no interrupt event, so checkpointing is a system-prompt instruction to call resume/search/summarize proactively; honest ceiling is semi-automatic since it depends on model compliance.
